gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diagnosis: relapsed/refractory solid tumours with positive uptake on SSTR-PET (PET-CT or PET-MRI), performed in the previous three months before entering the study.

candidate_evidence.quote: Study in children and adolescents of 177Lu DOTATATE (Lutathera®) combined with the PARP inhibitor olaparib

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Diagnosis: relapsed/refractory solid tumours with positive uptake on SSTR-PET (PET-CT or PET-MRI), performed in the previous three months before entering the study.

role_evidence.quote: 177Lu-DOTATATE will be administered intravenously, on day 1, every 8 weeks, at a fixed dose of 200 mCi (7.4 GBq)

agents.drug_class_hint: 177Lu-labelled somatostatin analogue (peptide receptor radionuclide therapy), isotope 177Lu
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: beta emission from 177Lu causes DNA single-strand breaks

role_evidence.quote: Olaparib will be administered PO, BID, days 3-28, every 8 weeks.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: PARP inhibition prevents repair of 177Lu-DOTATATE-induced single-strand breaks, leading to double-strand breaks and cell death

role_evidence.quote: an IV infusion of amino acid solution for renal protection23

source_quote.quote: Diagnosis: relapsed/refractory solid tumours with positive uptake on SSTR-PET (PET-CT or PET-MRI), performed in the previous three months before entering the study.

flag.reason: SSTR selection is measured by PET imaging; unclear whether it counts as a molecular biomarker for the primary outcome

coder_notes: Paediatric basket (18 months to 18 years at diagnosis) with glioblastoma named in conditions; registry stdAges includes ADULT. Amino acid infusion is given to every patient for renal protection and listed as supportive. SSTR is the target of the radioligand, hence candidate_matched true.
